answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for **shadow work** and **spiritual practice**, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s “Encounters with the Shadow,” Awake Academy’s transformational course directory, DailyOM’s “The Shadow Work Method to Heal,” and Catherine Liggett’s live Shadow Work course**.[4][9][18][12]

A practical shortlist, depending on what you want:

- **Best for Jungian depth:** **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform, because it is explicitly described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[5][9]
- **Best for a spirituality + psychology blend:** **Awake Academy** courses, which combine shadow work with mindfulness, Western psychology, insight training, Tibetan Buddhism, and more.[13]
- **Best for guided healing practice:** **The Shadow Work Method to Heal** on DailyOM, which focuses on uncovering psychological and energetic barriers in an 8-module format.[18]
- **Best for live, instructor-led learning:** **Shadow Work | Online Courses** by Catherine Liggett, which is offered as a 5-week live online course via Zoom.[12]
- **Best free/self-paced option:** **Hunt Your Own Shadow** by Zachary Phillips, a free 12-week self-paced course aimed at identifying limiting beliefs and unresolved traumas.[8]

Other notable options from the results:

- **Centre of Excellence – Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises**, which centers on discovering and integrating hidden or denied parts of yourself.[3]
- **Udemy – Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self**, which emphasizes self-mastery and spiritual awakening.[2]
- **Udemy – Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices**, which focuses on reducing reactivity and working with shadow parts.[6]
- **Udemy – Shadow Work Course and Workbook**, which includes meditations, prayers, practices, and a community component.[17]

If you want the *single best choice* for most people, I would start with **Jung Platform’s “Encounters with the Shadow”** for depth and credibility, and **Awake Academy** if you want the most explicitly spiritual framing.[4][13]

If you want, I can also turn this into a **ranked top 5 by price, depth, or spiritual orientation**.
